language: English as labeled by the publisher; original text only, no translated texts
year_rule: Exactly one distinct explicit four-digit 20xx year in the time field; never infer missing years
exclusion: Blank text; normalized or template-key match against the entire original corpus, including held-out data
deduplication: One first-row representative per lowercase/whitespace-normalized text within each eligible cohort

bootstrap.grouping: existing template_key on the original published text
bootstrap.method: whole-group percentile bootstrap; fixed model and observed external cohort

subgroups: Publisher scam category; descriptive counts and recall without selection or tuning
